label: s1_sub_006_woman_01
text: Ooohohoho! Ooohohoho![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_02
text: Look, Billy! What a wonderful little garden![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_01
text: Though this may look like a small garden to you,\ndearest O’Nare, it is in fact a full orchard![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_03
text: Come now—this? An orchard? You must be\njoking! I’ve never seen one so...humble![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_04
text: Thank you for the correction, Billy.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_02
text: No trouble at all! The ways of the commoner are\nshrouded in mystery...[VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_05
text: Ah, commoners! Such compelling creatures!\nThey always manage to get my heart racing![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_06
text: Hmm...? Speaking of commoners, isn’t that the\none we keep running into?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_03
text: You’re right! Your eyes do not deceive you—\nit’s the commoner we keep running into![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_07
text: Commoner! I wish to know more about you—to\nbecome more familiar with you![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_08
text: With that in mind, would you do me the honor of\nhaving another duel?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_04
text: Th-there it is! O’Nare’s favorite pastime—getting\nto know others through battle![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_09
text: Ohoho... Do let me know when you’re ready to\nduel, dear commoner.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_npc
text: A duel with a Glitterati is a once-in-a-lifetime\nopportunity! Quickly, speak with O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_10
text: A duel with yours truly! Do you accept?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_11
text:
You know, I think I quite like it when a commoner
tells me no now and then...\c
But the time of a Glitterati is exceedingly
valuable! We will have this battle RIGHT NOW![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_12
text: I, O’Nare—the president of Paldea Realty—will\ncrush you, commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_05
text: Pfwee, pfwee! Go get ’em, O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_13
text: I’ve lost again! Just what kind of commoner are\nyou, really?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_14
text: Say, Billy—do all commoners have Pokémon this\nstrong, or is this one...special?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_06
text: O’Nare, that commoner must have something\nonly a select few commoners possess.[VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_07
text: I believe they call it...gum-shun![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_15
text:
“Gum-shun”...? Oh! Oh yes! I’ve heard of this!
Yes, the commoners say it is the one thing no
Glitterati could ever possess!\c
However, Billy, I do believe the word is
“gumption.”[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_16
text: A commoner with gumption... Brilliant. As\neye-catching as a Pearl String. It’s no wonder\r\nI couldn’t best you.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_17
text: Speaking of pearls...I’d quite like to spend some\ntime by the waterside![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_woman_18
text: Come, Billy! Let us make our way to the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]biggest[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]body of water [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]in all of Paldea this instant![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_08
text: Pfwee! Your curiosity can be piqued at a\nmoment’s notice! You really are an exemplary\r\nGlitterati, dearest O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_man_09
text: Nothing washes away the weariness of battle\nlike a little R and R on an island shore![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_006_secretary_01
text: Lady O’Nare and Mr. Billy have gone off to see\na fruit farm somewhere here in Kitakami.
